subject: File sharing (default mode when unspecified)
notes: kb/Work PB322 determination A LANDED (w1013m). The default sharing mode is a function of the OPEN mode: OPEN INPUT establishes SHARING WITH READ ONLY and OPEN OUTPUT / I-O / EXTEND establish SHARING WITH NO OTHER (FileRegistry.ImplementorDefaultSharing, read once in SharedOpenAttempt: phrase ?? clause ?? default). Every arbitration is Table19.Conflicts, a plain lookup of the printed table; the null 'undetermined' mode, its universal quantifier and FileRegistry.Conflicts are deleted. The GnuCOBOL basis (rule 1) is the cross-run-unit lock posture (shared for input, exclusive otherwise). Golden 2002/pb322_default_sharing_by_open_mode pins the pairs (INPUT+INPUT 00/00, INPUT then I-O/EXTEND/OUTPUT 61, I-O then INPUT/I-O 61, LOCK MODE-only SELECT the same default, free again after the readers close); unit:OpenTable19Tests.ImplementorDefault_IsAFunctionOfTheOpenMode pins the function and its consequences over all 16 mode pairs. kb/Work PB670 LANDED (owner determination 2026-10-23, option (i)): at --std 85 the file sharing facility is not in effect (Annex A.4.7 is optional and A.4.1 makes its rules and I-O status values optional with it; the SHARING and LOCK MODE clauses are COBOL-2002 introductions). The implementor-defined default of 9.1.15 is the mode that restricts nobody: Table 19 is not asked, no file lock is taken against other run units, every OPEN of a file another connector holds answers 00 (OUTPUT beside a holder creates the empty file), a host refusal by a process outside the run unit answers 30, and 61 is never produced. One read: DialectBehavior.FileSharingFacility through FileConnector.SharingFacilityInEffect. Golden pb670_cobol85_no_sharing_facility (GnuCOBOL -std=cobol85 gives the same statuses); SharingFacilityEditionTests pins every pair of opens in every organization at 85 and at 2002. retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Runtime/IO/FileRegistry.cs#Conflicts (FileRegistry.Conflicts was deleted; Table19.Conflicts (OpenTable19.cs) is the one arbitration lookup)
